method: candidate lines proposed by corridor detection; identity decided from printed address runs
why_not_one_block_off: PRINTED NAME: the corridor is lettered AVENUE L down the roadway on BOTH sheets - on sheet 85 the letter L sits at native (~1240, y~1790) with AVENUE below it, inside the corridor whose east face is at 1298.6, and the roadway width 70' is printed at ~1252 in the seam row; on sheet 93 AVENUE L is lettered at native ~2170. AVENUE-FACE RUNS: on 85 the east face of Ave L carries 4001-4027 (block 40, the 40th-41st segment) and 4101-4127 (block 41, 41st-42nd); on 93 the east face carries 4201-4225 (block 42, 42nd-43rd) and 4301-4327 (block 43, 43rd-44th). CROSS-STREET RUNS (the hundred-block test): on sheet 85 along 41st St the run east of the line begins 1201 1203 1205 (1202 1204 1206 on the north face) and along 42nd St, the seam street, 1202 1204 1206 | 1201 1203 1205; the run WEST of Ave L, read in the K-L column on 40th St (block 99), ends 1120 1122 1124 - a 1100|1200 transition. On sheet 93 along 42nd St the run east of the line begins 1201 1203 1205 and along 43rd St the run west of it (block 103, K-L column) ends 1119 1121 1123 - the same 1100|1200 transition. ONE BLOCK WEST is AVENUE K - on 85's main map at native ~198, on 93 at ~1168 - where the runs go 1000|1100. ONE BLOCK EAST is AVENUE M - on 85 at 2199.3, on 93 at ~3157 - where the runs go 1200|1300. Neither shows a 1100|1200 break, so neither can be this line. NOTE ON EQUAL-NATIVE-X (rejected): sheet 93's grid sits ~970 px EAST of sheet 85's, so matching by near-equal native x would tie Ave L on 93 (2164.0) to Ave M on 85 (2199.3) - exactly one block off. The proposed candidates (85: 670 / 1712 / 2755; 93: 722 / 1747 / 2772) pair off by near-equal native x and are that artefact; none is a corridor - on 85 the 20-ft mid-block alleys sit at 1696.7 and 2698.6 and the candidates 1712 / 2755 fall just east of them, and on 93 the alleys sit at ~1662 and 2660.6 with 1747 / 2772 likewise.
measurement_note: Native x = raster x of work/sheets/1912w/u<unit>.jpg (3327x3898), origin top-left. Measured in the block row ADJACENT to the 42nd St seam: sheet 85 the 41st-42nd row (evaluated y=3200), sheet 93 the 42nd-43rd row (evaluated y=940). SHEET 93 is direct: both faces of Ave L are printed, 2060.8 (east edge of the Cemetery tract) and 2267.0 (west face of block 42), width 206.2, centre 2163.9; the 43rd-44th row gives 2064.4 / 2274.4 -> 2169.4, the plate drifting ~5 px over that height, so the seam-row value is the one that registers. SHEET 85 IS A COMPOSITE and needs care: it carries an inset panel with its own north arrow and its own '77' tag filling the paper south of native y~1857 and west of x~1190, drawn about 960 px EAST of true position (the inset puts Ave J at ~143 and Ave K at ~1131, whereas the main map puts Ave K at ~198). Its heavy border runs down native x 1180-1203 and masks the WESTERN half of the Ave L roadway in the seam row, so the centre is fixed from the printed EAST face, 1298.6, minus half the plate's own 70-ft roadway (Ave M in the same row measures 2094.2 / 2303.5 = 209.3 wide) -> 1194.0. Two independent routes agree: the 20-ft alley of the L-M column (centre 1696.7) mirrored about Ave M (2199.3) gives 1194.2; and Ave L measured directly higher up the same plate, where both faces are clear, gives 1188.0 (39th-40th row, faces 1083.1 / 1292.9) and 1191.2 (y1600-1840, faces 1086.5 / 1295.8), drifting ~+3 px per 1100 rows toward the seam. Reported value 1194.1. Sheet 93 also carries an inset (block 12, 45th-46th, J-K column, top-left, border down x~1146 and along y~1490) but it does not touch the 42nd St seam and does not affect this reading. Ave M was considered as the alternative control and rejected: on sheet 93 its east face runs off the printed area at the sheet's east border, so only Ave L is fully drawn on both plates near the seam.
